test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The Morbi bridge mishap has left Gujarat in a __deplorable __state.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"deplorable"** means deserving strong condemnation or shockingly bad in quality. (निंदनीय)

 
 
• **Example: **The living conditions in the slum were **deplorable.**
 
 
 
• **"Despicable"** refers to something that is deserving hatred and contempt. (घृणित)
 
 
• **Example: **Stealing from the poor is a **despicable** act.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'deplorable'** is **'despicable'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Jubilation** (उल्लास): A feeling of great happiness and triumph.

 
 
• **Example:** The team was in jubilation after winning the championship.
 
 
 
• **Complaining** (शिकायत करना): Expressing dissatisfaction or annoyance about something.
 
 
• **Example: **She kept complaining about the cold weather.
 
 
 
• **Rejoicing** (आनंदित होना): Feeling or showing great joy or delight.
 
 
• **Example:** There was much rejoicing at the news of the victory.
 
 

134:Td68,

The correct answer is: **Option 3**.<
